title.en: Practical 6: Water of hydration (crystallisation) in a salt

text.en: Blue crystals hide water inside them.

The aim is to check whether the given salt contains water of crystallisation or hydration.
Heat a pinch of crystalline copper sulphate in a test tube for some time. If water droplets appear on the inner walls of the tube, the salt contains water of crystallisation.
If no droplets are seen, the water of hydration is absent. Write in the result whether it is present or absent.
